title: Bat
wikitext:
[[image:VampireBat.png|thumb|]]

Bats are nocturnal, flying mammals that usually feed on fruit and insects.  Most are no bigger than the average bird.  There are a number of bat species in [[WoW]] that grow to enormous size and pose a threat to [[player]]s.
Some of them are useful mounts for the [[Jungle Trolls]] and [[Undead]].  Bats are found in [[Tirisfal Glades]], [[Blackrock Depths]], [[Shadowfang Keep]], [[Zul'Gurub]], [[Razorfen Kraul]], the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], and [[Uldaman]].

Additional notes:
* Bats may be [[neutral]] or [[hostile]], depending on their species.

=== Examples ===
* Vampire Bat
* Duskbat
* Plaguebat
* Bloodseeker Bat

===  As A [[Hunter]] Pet ===
* Have high DPS, medium HP, and low armor.
* Eats only Fruit and Fungus.
* Can learn [[Cower]], [[Growl]], [[Dive]], [[Bite]], and [[Screech]].
* The [[Bloodseeker Bat]] of [[Zul'Gurub]] is currently immensely popular because of its 1.0 attack speed. However, this is pending to change in an upcoming normalisation patch.

=== Method of Transportation ===

See [[Vampire Bat]].
